hya_boss_capture_help: Save the three boss candidates at the start of each run to log/hyakkiyakou/boss_capture, used to train rarity recognition. About 0.7MB per run.
hya_bean_capture_help: Save frames to data/bean_capture (raw + old-model prelabels) for training new shikigami detection.
hya_bean_empty_every_help: Also save one frame every N seconds when nothing is detected.
hya_bean_prelabel_help: Write X-AnyLabeling JSON under prelabel/; boxes are suggestions only.
hya_detector_mode_help: Auto follows the workbench; Old, Shadow, Assist and Primary are explicit overrides.
hya_detector_manifest_help: active.json written after publishing a model.
hya_detector_timeout_ms_help: On timeout, the current frame falls back to the old model.
hya_detector_log_help: Write at most one summary per second under log/hyakkiyakou.
hya_ur_help: Focus score for UR targets detected by the new model.
